summary: from __future__ import unicode_literals is an anti-pattern because it hides whether literals are bytes or text, prevents native string literals, and forces context switches between files.
questions: Should I use unicode_literals in Ansible code?

answer_card.title: no-unicode-literals
answer_card.answer_md: Don't. It makes bare literals ambiguous without checking the file top, removes native-string literals, and forces you to switch mental models between files.
